name: WindowManagerProvider
description:
Provide a window manager to the tree and connect it (load the persisted layout, join
cross-tab sync) before the first paint after hydration.
signature: ({ manager, children }: { manager: WindowManager; children: ReactNode; }): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: manager
props.description: Window manager that owns descriptors, focus, layout and persistence.
